mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in a month and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% in a month and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is positive, signaling a tightening monetary policy and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in a month and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) is increasing and Real GDP (GDPC1) is decreasing, it signals a supply-driven economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases and GDPC1 decreases and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
